title: Star Trek and X-Men actor Patrick Stewart dies at 86
caption:
Sir Patrick Stewart, known as Captain Picard in Star Trek and Professor X in X-Men, has died at 86 at his home in Los Angeles, his family says. He spent 16 years with the Royal Shakespeare Company before Hollywood. Marvel says he will still appear in Avengers: Doomsday in December.

One story. Twice a day. Follow for the next edition.
